Requirement Statement: The SKYPORT-HUB system SHALL execute full aircraft ground turnaround processing from touchdown to liftoff.
The Megawatt Fast-Charging Gantry SHALL deliver continuous high-voltage direct current to the aircraft interface.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Output voltage up to 1000 VDC at ≥ 1000 A charging current.

Requirement Statement: The Automated Battery Swap Arm SHALL physically unlatch, extract, replace, and lock aircraft battery modules.
The charging interface cooling loop SHALL maintain battery module skin temperatures within safe thermal thresholds during fast charging.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Battery thermal limits maintained < 60°C throughout cycle.

Requirement Statement: The landing pad (FATO/TLOF) SHALL provide physical clearance envelopes sized for multi-rotor eVTOL aircraft wingspans.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Spatial clearance envelope ≥ 1.5× maximum aircraft D-value.

Requirement Statement: The vertiport perimeter SHALL include blast fencing engineered to redirect rotor downwash velocity away from passenger corridors.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Downwash velocity at passenger gate < 20 knots during hover.

Requirement Statement: The AOI inspection drone SHALL scan critical airframe surfaces, rotor blades, and landing gear for structural defects post-landing.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Surface defect resolution down to 0.5 mm flaw detection.

Requirement Statement: The AOI drone mission SHALL complete its automated inspection sweep without extending the baseline turnaround schedule.
The ground control panel SHALL operate safety relay logic on isolated low-voltage control circuits.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Control circuit voltage standard of 24 VDC.

Requirement Statement: The high-power distribution unit SHALL isolate grid power from the charging gantry using physical safety interlocks during docking.
Target Acceptance Criteria: 480 VAC primary power isolation within 50 ms of unlatch signal.

Requirement Statement: The facility SHALL feature hardwired Emergency Power-Off (EPO) circuits accessible at all control stations.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Total high-power grid disconnection response time < 20 ms upon EPO trigger.

Requirement Statement: The supervisory Ground Control Station SHALL maintain real-time bidirectional telemetry communication with incoming aircraft.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Data telemetry latency < 100 ms over Ethernet/IP link.

Requirement Statement: The UTM software layer SHALL automatically synchronize vertiport pad availability status with regional airspace management networks.
Passenger boarding bridges SHALL remain physically locked until the aircraft is stationary and charging interlocks are engaged.
Target Acceptance Criteria: Zero gate access permitted while rotors are turning or fast-charging is active.

Requirement Statement: The ground handling system SHALL maintain high overall system availability (Ao) across continuous 24/7 commercial operational shifts.
Verification Methods key: I = Inspection, A = Analysis, D = Demonstration, T = Test.
